n8n-vs-zapier.title: n8n vs Zapier (2026): pricing, self-hosting & which to pick
n8n-vs-zapier.description: n8n vs Zapier compared with checked Oct 2026 pricing: n8n bills per workflow run and can be self-hosted free; Zapier bills per task and connects 9,000+ apps.
n8n-vs-zapier.bottomLine: Pick Zapier if you want the biggest app catalog and the quickest no-code setup and your Zaps have only a few steps. Pick n8n if you are comfortable with a more technical tool, want to self-host for free or keep data on your own server, or run long multi-step workflows: n8n counts one execution per full run, while Zapier counts a task for every successful action step.

Per task: every successful action step counts (triggers and built-in tools like Filter, Formatter and Paths don't)

faq: It depends on your workflows. n8n Cloud starts at €20/month (billed annually) and charges per full workflow run; Zapier Professional starts at $19.99/month (billed annually) for 750 tasks, and every successful action step uses a task. For long multi-step workflows n8n usually works out cheaper, and self-hosted n8n Community Edition is free. Prices checked Oct 20, 2026.
Can I self-host Zapier like n8n?
No. Zapier only runs in its own cloud. n8n can be self-hosted for free with the Community Edition, or used on n8n Cloud.
Does Zapier have a free plan?
Yes: 100 tasks per month with two-step Zaps (one trigger, one action). Multi-step Zaps, premium apps and webhooks need a paid plan.

chatgpt-vs-claude.title: ChatGPT vs Claude (2026): pricing, coding & which to pick
chatgpt-vs-claude.description: ChatGPT vs Claude compared with checked Oct 2026 plan pages: Claude Pro is $20/month or $17/month billed annually ($200). ChatGPT offers Free, Go, Plus and Pro individual tiers (Plus includes Codex and deep research). Claude Code is on Claude Pro.
chatgpt-vs-claude.bottomLine: Pick ChatGPT if you want the largest consumer ecosystem, plugins, image gen, Codex and deep research on Plus (or higher). Pick Claude if you want Claude Code, Artifacts and an optional cheaper annual Pro ($17/month billed as $200/year; $20 monthly). Both have free tiers; heavy daily use may need ChatGPT Pro or Claude Max (from $100/month).

faq: Is Claude Pro cheaper than ChatGPT Plus?

Claude Pro is $20/month or $17/month if you pay $200 for the year. ChatGPT lists Free, Go, Plus and Pro; check openai.com/chatgpt/pricing for the current Plus amount in your country. Prices checked Oct 21, 2026; tax may apply.
Does ChatGPT Plus include a coding agent like Claude Code?
Plus includes OpenAI's coding tools (Codex and related features) that share the plan's usage. Claude Pro includes Claude Code in the terminal and desktop, also sharing the same usage pool as chat.

Either free tier is enough to try. If you mostly chat and want plugins or image tools, start with ChatGPT. If you want to build small apps or long docs in the chat (Artifacts) or try an agent in the terminal, start with Claude.
